subject: Disability Resource Fair Planning
overview: The Medford Commission for Persons with Disabilities discussed planning for an upcoming October resource fair, addressed Open Meeting Law compliance for working groups, and recognized retiring member Marcia Kirssen. The commission also voted to table approval of its previous meeting minutes to September.

items.title: Call to order and introductions
items.summary: Commission members introduced themselves and noted this was the final meeting for member Marcia Kirssen.

items.title: Approval of minutes
items.summary: The commission approved a motion to table the review and approval of the May minutes until September to allow members adequate time to read them.

items.title: Open Meeting Law presentation feedback and discussion
items.summary: Members reviewed the recent Open Meeting Law training, discussing how to communicate and collaborate on working groups and subcommittees between meetings while adhering to public meeting laws.

items.title: Disability resource fair planning
items.summary: The commission discussed logistics for the October 7 resource fair at the Brooks School, reviewing flyer design, social media text, incorporating disability pride symbols, vendor scheduling, and budget constraints for promotional items like magnets, stickers, and Braille business cards.

items.title: Commissioner recruitment
items.summary: The commission discussed ongoing efforts to recruit new members and explored potential outreach to local high school students.

items.title: Announcements and recognition of Commissioner Kirssen
items.summary: Commissioners recognized and thanked retiring member Marcia Kirssen for her years of service and community advocacy.

items.title: Public participation
items.summary: The chair opened the floor for public participation, but no members of the public were present.
